review.title: LEAVE A REVIEW
review.pitch: A few words on the store page help other commanders find the game.

products.title: Clash of Crests
products.blurb: Take the castle. The full game: every nation, campaigns and scenarios, 8-player LAN, and the siege train that breaks walls, with hex battles where each counter is one warrior.

products.title: Wallace
products.blurb: Scotland rises. Ride with Wallace, Robert the Bruce and the Pictish clans against Longshanks: a three-chapter campaign of ambush, open battle and siege, two new nations and 129 units.

products.title: Eaters of the Dead
products.blurb: The Norse come south. Follow Buliwyf's thirteen through six chapters, men by day and the wendol by night, and field a full Nordic nation of berserkers, longships and siege engines.

products.title: Dangers and Wonders
products.blurb: Walk the darker half of the world. Spellbooks and five schools of magic, relic wonders that turn a battle, delve maps and dungeon quests.

products.title: The Friar's Scepter
products.blurb: Sherwood's darker tale: a three-chapter campaign, six standalone battles and the creatures of the greenwood.

products.title: Maid of Orléans
products.blurb: The French rise under Joan of Arc: a fifteen-chapter campaign, the Rescue of the Maid, a new nation and its crest.

products.title: The Sable Cross
products.blurb: Take the black cross into the Fenmarch: four battles through bog and reed against clans never conquered, and 83 units of the Teutonic Order.

products.title: Camelot
products.blurb: King Arthur and the Round Table against Morgana le Fay. Three campaigns, twelve chapters: ride for Camelot or for Morgana's Host from the Forest Perilous to Camlann, then follow the Grail to Corbenic.

products.title: The High Seas
products.blurb: A dead man's chart and a corsair's hoard. Land on the Corsair Isles, race the tide through the Smugglers' Tunnel and run the Skull Reef, then meet Blackbeard, the Kraken and the White Whale on open water. 49 ships, 13 pirate captains and their crews.

products.title: The Wild Marches
products.blurb: Past the edge of the kingdom lie the Wild Marches. Gather a company at three quest-fires, travel a map of 52 places and fight 27 battles, most on a fresh map every run: trolls, wolves, barrow-dead, a dragon, and the fae of the Elderwood beyond the Broken Gate.

products.title: The Purple and the Fire
products.blurb: Two campaigns of the Eastern Roman Empire. Serve with Harald Sigurdsson in the Varangian Guard from the Golden Horn to Sicily and the palace riot of 1042, then hold Constantinople with Leo III against the Arab siege of 717. 20 units, Greek fire and kataphraktoi.

products.title: The Golden Spurs
products.blurb: Flanders, 1302. Rise with the weavers and butchers of Bruges, take Ghent and the castle of Courtrai, then hold the Groeninge brook against the flower of French chivalry. A five-chapter campaign with a side chapter, two new nations and 44 units with pikes, crossbows and the goedendag.

products.title: Sisters of the Glade
products.blurb: Sherwood's women riders keep the greenwood's law. Ride with the Sisters of the Glade through a four-chapter campaign against the Free Company, Goimar's reavers, a poisoned run over the downs and seven dark riders. 50 units, with Robin's Merry Men and the Sheriff's Men.
